posts.query:
SELECT M.mukey, M.musym, M.muname, A.drclassdcd, A.flodfreqdcd, A.hydclprs, L.areasymbol, L.areaname, S.saverest
FROM mapunit M LEFT JOIN muaggatt A ON A.mukey = M.mukey JOIN legend L ON L.lkey = M.lkey LEFT JOIN sacatalog S ON S.areasymbol = L.areasymbol
WHERE M.mukey IN (SELECT * FROM SDA_Get_Mukey_from_intersection_with_WktWgs84('point(-66.015700 18.006300)'))

Table: Humacao Area, Puerto Rico Eastern Part

posts.query:
SELECT P.mukey, M.musym, M.muname, A.drclassdcd, A.flodfreqdcd, A.hydclprs, L.areasymbol, L.areaname, S.saverest, P.mupolygongeo.STIntersection(geometry::STGeomFromText('POLYGON((-66.0156919 18.0063585, -66.0157082 18.0062153, -66.0158219 18.0062607, -66.0157791 18.0063692, -66.0157731 18.0063695, -66.0156919 18.0063585))', 4326).MakeValid().STBuffer(0.0002)).STAsText() AS wkt
FROM mupolygon P JOIN mapunit M ON M.mukey = P.mukey LEFT JOIN muaggatt A ON A.mukey = P.mukey JOIN legend L ON L.lkey = M.lkey LEFT JOIN sacatalog S ON S.areasymbol = L.areasymbol
WHERE P.mupolygongeo.STIntersects(geometry::STGeomFromText('POLYGON((-66.0156919 18.0063585, -66.0157082 18.0062153, -66.0158219 18.0062607, -66.0157791 18.0063692, -66.0157731 18.0063695, -66.0156919 18.0063585))', 4326).MakeValid()) = 1

Table: Humacao Area, Puerto Rico Eastern Part
